claim_limits: A valid derivation edge establishes lineage, not bytewise equivalence or runtime behavior.
Parent-file ranges identify bytes in the immediate parent task, not automatically in the original input.
Child task chunk offsets are task-local; root_file_range must remain null unless the evidence contract explicitly supports such a direct mapping.
Public oracle is known-answer regression data, not a blind generalization benchmark.
No case requires or authorizes executing extracted vendor firmware or touching physical hardware.
